site.name: tablerose
site.summary: tablerose-clone Fictional restaurant reservation platform "Tablerose" multi-page booking flow. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Discovery: hero with 5-field search card (city autocomplete / party / date / time); 5 quick-pill suggestions; 6-card "reserved most this week" trending grid; 4-card editor guides; 3-step "how it works" | | `restaurants.html` | Results: top reservation summary bar with Edit; left filter rail (8 cuisines, 4 price tiers, 6 neighborhoods, 6 features); 10-row results list with photo / name / stars / blurb / tags / per-row time slots (slots within ±30min of search are highlighted, others muted); sort dropdown (relevance / rating / price / distance) | | `restaurant.html` | Detail: split hero (photo / info with stars / dress / hours); 4 tabs (Overview with about, highlights table; Menu with 3 sections; Photos with 9 swatches; Reviews with rating bars + 3 reviews); right-side sticky booking card (date / party / 10 time slots — 30min near target highlighted, 17:00/21:30 disabled for Bella Suora); SVG mini-map; favorite heart toggle |

run_plan.goal: End-to-end exploration and UX critique of Tablerose’s restaurant discovery-to-booking checkout flow, including key recovery/edge states across desktop and mobile.
run_plan.summary: Start at index.html and drive the primary booking path by using the search card to reach restaurants.html, then open restaurant.html from a highlighted result and complete the 4-step booking through guest.html, payment.html, and confirmation.html. In parallel, validate adjacent navigation/editor-guide paths, filtering/sorting behaviors, and critical disabled/required-card-holder rules shown in the prescan. Repeat critical booking and review interactions on mobile viewport to catch tap-target and layout issues.
assumptions: Navigation flows are implemented as separate HTML pages: index.html -> restaurants.html -> restaurant.html -> guest.html -> payment.html -> confirmation.html.
The date/time highlighting on restaurants.html is based on closeness to the search input time (±30 minutes), and some time slots may be disabled on restaurant.html.
A card hold requirement exists on payment.html for parties of 6+ or peak-night reservations, and the UI communicates a $50/seat no-show fee and a $100 authorization hold.
Certain inline controls (top nav links, restaurant cards, booking tabs, etc.) have small tap targets or missing labels per prescan, making them high risk on mobile.
risk_hotspots: index.html: small tap targets in top navigation and quick suggestion pills; validate usability on mobile (ux-1..ux-7, ux-13..ux-17).
restaurants.html: filter rail controls (cuisine, price, neighborhood, features) + sort dropdown + 'Edit' reservation summary bar; validate correctness and reset behavior.
restaurant.html: right-side sticky booking card with date/party/time slots; validate disabled slots and highlighted near-target slots.
restaurant.html: favorite heart toggle and 4 tabs (Overview/Menu/Photos/Reviews); validate tab switching and state persistence.
guest.html: guest details form with many diet/occasion fields; validate validation, character counter for special request, and required/optional fields before continuing.
payment.html: card input fields + payment method toggles (Apple Pay/Google Pay) + add-on selectors affecting seats-based totals; validate agreement links and 'Hold the table' action behavior.
confirmation.html: modify/cancel recovery path and add-to-calendar links; validate that reservation details render correctly (no 'undefined' values).

phases.title: Discover & Search Entry (index.html)
phases.objective: Validate the primary discovery/search entry points, including quick suggestions and hero search form fields, then confirm navigation into results.
key_checks: Use WHERE (city/neighborhood) input (ux-8) and DATE (ux-10) plus PARTY selector to run a search via 'Find tables →' button.
Click at least one trending quick suggestion pill (e.g., '🍝 Pasta · 6 nearby', '🍣 Sushi · 9 nearby') and confirm it routes to restaurants.html with coherent parameters.
Select a time value in the TIME row (5:30 pm..9:00 pm visible) and ensure it impacts subsequent highlighting on restaurants.html.
Exercise top navigation links (Tablerose/Discover/Cities/For restaurants/Help) to ensure they don’t trap the flow; confirm they route as expected or scroll appropriately.
Mobile check: ensure tap targets for header links and quick pills are usable; confirm search card is not overlapped.
exit_criteria: A successful navigation to restaurants.html occurs from both: (1) the search card and (2) at least one quick suggestion click.
Chosen DATE/TIME/PARTY selections visibly carry forward (e.g., results page summary bar reflects the selection).

phases.title: Results Discovery & Filtering (restaurants.html)
phases.objective: Validate results list rendering, time-slot highlighting logic (±30min), and filter/sort interactions with reset behavior.
key_checks: Use the 'Edit' control on the top reservation summary bar to ensure it allows returning to adjust search parameters.
Toggle multiple filters: one Cuisine, one Price tier, one Neighborhood, and one Feature; verify counts update and results list changes accordingly.
Use 'Reset filters' and verify all filters clear to defaults.
Use sort dropdown (Relevance/Highest rated/Price low-high/Price high-low/Nearest) and verify ordering changes.
Open restaurant.html from at least one listing; prefer a listing whose per-row time slots show both enabled and visually muted/disabled states relative to the search time.
Mobile check: validate filter rail usability (small tap targets risk) and that the results list remains readable without clipping.
exit_criteria: At least one successful navigation from restaurants.html to restaurant.html using a result listing.
Filter/sort/reset operations visibly affect the results list without breaking layout or leaving the page in an inconsistent state.

phases.title: Restaurant Detail & Booking Slot Selection (restaurant.html)
phases.objective: Validate core detail-to-booking transition: tabs, favorite heart, sticky booking card interactions, and handling disabled vs highlighted time slots.
key_checks: Click the favorite heart toggle (♡) and confirm it visually changes state (and if applicable persists on return).
Switch through the 4 tabs (Overview, Menu, Photos, Reviews) and confirm each tab renders its content area correctly.
In the sticky booking card, set or confirm PARTY and choose a time slot that is highlighted as near target (±30min) and then verify navigation readiness.
Attempt selecting a disabled time slot example (prescan notes 17:00 and 21:30 disabled for Bella Suora) and confirm the UI prevents selection with an appropriate disabled state.
Validate that the mini-map SVG is non-interactive/doesn’t break layout; ensure it doesn’t block booking card controls.
Mobile check: confirm sticky booking card remains reachable without covering primary content or causing accidental tap misfires.
exit_criteria: A time slot is selected successfully from the sticky booking card and leads onward to guest.html (or directly to the next step per flow).
Disabled slots cannot be selected; highlighted slots are selectable and lead to booking steps.

phases.title: Guest Details Form (guest.html)
phases.objective: Validate the multi-field guest information capture, optional dietary and request inputs, occasion selection, and continuation into payment.
key_checks: Fill First name and Last name; ensure required/format expectations are respected.
Add Phone and Email; verify that email/phone fields do not clear unexpectedly and that form submission is possible with valid data.
Toggle at least two dietary inputs (e.g., Vegetarian + Gluten-free) and confirm selections render as expected.
Add a Special request in the textarea and verify the character counter (0 / 240) updates and limits are enforced.
Select an occasion chip (e.g., 🎂 Birthday) and verify it appears in the summary.
Proceed to the next step and confirm the reservation summary (Restaurant/Date/Time/Party) persists correctly.
Mobile check: validate small-tap targets for diet/occasion controls and that keyboard focus is clear.
exit_criteria: Guest form submits successfully and transitions to payment.html with correct reservation summary and selections.

phases.title: Card Hold & Add-ons (payment.html)
phases.objective: Validate payment hold messaging, payment method UI, add-on pricing calculation, and final submit into confirmation.
key_checks: Verify the card hold explanation and fee terms are visible: $50/seat no-show fee and $100 card authorization (released if cancel by stated time).
Select a payment method option (Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay) and ensure the UI updates appropriately (even if actual payment is mocked).
Enter Card number, Expiry, CVC, and Postal code; confirm field masking/formatting and no broken validation indicators.
Toggle at least one add-on option (e.g., 🎂 Happy Birthday +$8 or 🥂 prosecco +$12 × seats) and confirm the add-ons total updates correctly.
Open the no-show policy link (agreement) and verify it doesn’t break flow (back works).
Complete by clicking 'Hold the table' and confirm navigation to confirmation.html.
exit_criteria: Payment step completes successfully and confirmation.html loads with a consistent reservation/ref details.
Add-ons total reflects selected items and seat multiplication behavior.

phases.title: Confirmation & Recovery (confirmation.html)
phases.objective: Validate that booking success states render correctly and that modify/cancel/help recovery paths work without losing reservation details.
key_checks: Verify reservation identifiers and summary (e.g., TR-784521, date/time/party) render without 'undefined' placeholders.
Use 'Add to calendar' options (Apple/Google/Outlook) and confirm they trigger expected UI actions (or safe no-op in this environment).
Click 'Modify' and ensure the flow returns to an editable booking step without losing core info.
Click 'Cancel' and confirm messaging/behavior is consistent (may lead to discover or allow rebooking).
Check 'Resend email' to ensure the action is available and doesn’t error in the UI.
Mobile check: confirm confirmation actions remain reachable and not overlapped.
exit_criteria: Confirmation page actions (calendar, resend email, modify/cancel) can be triggered and the UI stays coherent.
Reservation details on confirmation are fully populated.

coverage_targets.pages: visit all known HTML pages: index.html, restaurants.html, restaurant.html, guest.html, payment.html, confirmation.html.
coverage_targets.features: exercise most visible controls per key page: search card inputs + quick pills; filters/sort/reset on results; tabs + favorite toggle + sticky booking card time selection on restaurant detail; guest form diet/occasion/special request; payment card inputs/add-ons; confirmation calendar/modification/cancellation/resend actions.
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat the critical booking path (index -> restaurants -> restaurant -> guest -> payment -> confirmation) and verify reachability of sticky booking card + main action buttons; also validate header/quick-pill tap targets flagged as small in prescan.

notes: Execution should favor one complete booking run plus one alternate attempt that triggers a disabled time slot state on restaurant.html to validate error prevention.
The prescan excerpt shows 'for undefined guest' on confirmation; include an explicit check that guest name/party fields are not undefined after a full run.
